Plea,Ⓒs.ⒹkAraRottaraM, uttaraM, uttarapAdaH.
Ⓑ
 2 vyapadeSaH, Cadman n., apadeSaH, nimittaM, kAraRaM, mocanahetuH.
Ⓑ
 3 vAdaH, vyavahAraH, kAryaM.
Ⓑ
 4 prArTanA; ‘raising a p(lea)’ DvajIkaraRaM.
ⓃPlead,Ⓒv.ⒹuttaraM dA 3 U or pratipad 4 A or vad 1 P, nimittaM dfS c., vi-, apa-diS 6 P; ‘p(lead) guilty’ aparADI asmIti vad or pratipad; ‘tears shall p(lead) in vain’ aSrupAto nirguRo Bavet.
Ⓑ
 2 vinayena prArT or aByarT 10 A, savinayaM yAc 1 A; ‘p(lead)ed for his life’ jIvitadAnArTaM prArTayAmAsa.
Ⓑ
 3 upa-kzip 6 P, upanyas 4 U, vyapadeSArTaM puraH kzip.
Ⓑ
 4 (Cause) pratipad c., parArTaM uttaraM vad, parapakzaM samarT; ‘p(lead)ing headache as an excuse’ SiraHSUlasparSaM vyapa-diSan; ‘p(lead)ing illness’ asvAsTyavyAjena-vyapadeSena.
Ⓝ[Plead]er,Ⓒs.ⒹaBiBAzakaH, uttaravAdin m. samarTakaH, hetuvAdin m.
Ⓝ[Plead]ing,Ⓒs.Ⓓhetu-uttara-vAdaH, vyapadeSanaM, hetUpanyAsaH.

Please,Ⓒv. t.ⒹprI 9 P, 10 (prIRayati), tfp c., saM-pari-°, ram c. (ramayati), pramud c., suKayati (D.), A-naMd c., saM-, tuz c., prasad c., AhlAd c., hfz c., ArAD c., anuraMj c.; oft. by icCA, prasAdaH, kfpA; vizamapyamftaM kvacidBavedamftaM vA vizamISvarecCayA (R. viii. 46) ‘if it p(lease) God to do so’ &c.; ‘he was p(leas)ed to accept my presents’ mamopAyanAni sa suprItamanasA-suprasannaM-svIcakAra; ‘may it p(lease) your ladyship’ prasIdatu BawwinI (M. 4).
Ⓑ
 2 (Like) See below.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓ‘to be p(leas)ed’ tuz 4 P, tfp 4 P; ram-mud 1 A, naMd 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 arh 1 P or prasad 1 P, with inf., or simply by Imperative; ‘p(lease) sit here’ atropavi-SatvAryaH; ‘worthy Sir, p(lease) to wait for 2 or 3 days’ dvitrARyahAnyarhasi soQumarhan (R. v. 25).
Ⓑ
 3 ruc 1 A, iz 6 P; See Like; ‘just as my friend p(lease)s’ yadaBi-rocate vayasyAya; ‘do as you p(lease)’ yaTABilazitaM kriyatAM.
Ⓝ[Pleas]ance,Ⓒs.ⒹkrIqodyAna.
Ⓝ[Pleas]ant,Ⓒa.ⒹsuKakara (rI f.), maDura, suKada-prada, suKAvaha, ramya, ramaRIya, priya, manohara-rama, aBirAma, suBaga, aBimata, suKa, kAmya, kAMta, harzAvaha, rucira, hfdya, hfdayaMgama, prIti-tuzwi-kara, manojYa, maMjula, cAru; ‘a p(leasant) joke’ hfdayaMgamaH parihAsaH (Mal. 3).
Ⓝ[Pleas]antly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsuKaM, ramyaM, maDuraM, priyaM, ruciraM.
Ⓝ[Pleas]antry,Ⓒs.Ⓓpari(rI)hAsaH, narmaBAzitaM, vinodaH, narmAlApaH, vinoda-narma-ukti f.
Ⓝ[Pleas]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹsuKa in comp.; ramya, kAMta; See Pleasant, ‘p(leasing) to the ear’ suKaSrava, SrutisuKa, maMjula-svana, suSrAvya; ‘p(leasing) to the eye’ prekzaRIya, nayanABirAma, sudfSya; ‘p(leasing) language’ cAwu m. n., cAwUktiH.
Ⓝ[Pleas]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsuBagaM, suKaM, suKa-cAru in comp.
ⓃPleasure,Ⓒs.ⒹsuKaM, saM-pari-tozaH, AnaMdaH, prIti f., sOKyaM, tuzwi f., pra-, modaH, AhlAdaH, harzaH, mudA.
Ⓑ
 2 aBi-, ruci f., icCA, aBilAzaH, CaMdaH-das n., kAmaH; ‘at oneʼs p(leasure)’ svecCayA, kAmataH, yaTAkAmaM, yadfcCayA, svEraM; ‘wandering at p(leasure)’ kAmacArin^1, svacCaMda-gAmin; ‘sensual p(leasure)’ BogaH, vizayasuKaM, vizayAnurAgaH; ‘sexual p(leasure)’ rati f., rati-suKaM, su-, rataM; ‘p(leasure)-boat’ keli-krIqA-nOkA; ‘p(leasure)-ground’ ArAmaH, krIqA-keli-vilAsa-vanaM-kAnanaM, pramadavanaM, krIqodyAnaM; ‘p(leasure)-mansion’ keligfhaM-BavanaM, lIlAgAraM, vilAsamaMdiraM.
Ⓑ
 3 prasAdaH, anugrahaH.
Ⓝ[Pleasur]able,Ⓒa.Ⓓramya, ramaRIya, suKada, suKa; See Pleasant.
Ⓝ[Pleasur]ist,Ⓒs.Ⓓvizayin m., vizayAsaktaH, BogA-saktaH, BogaparAyaRaH.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20161220.

Plebian,Ⓒa.ⒹprAkfta (tI f.), sAmAnya, sADAraRa (RI f.), avaravarRa, akulIna.
Ⓔs.ⒹprAkftaH, prAkftajanaH, pfTagjanaH; nIca-avara-janaH.

Pledge,Ⓒs.ⒹnyAsaH, nikzepaH, ADiH, upaniDiH, upanyAsaH-nikzepaH, paRaH.
Ⓑ
 2 aBijYAnaM; ‘p(ledge) of love’ prItyaBijYAnaM.
Ⓑ
 3 pratijYA, kzaRaH, paripaRaH-RanaM; ‘I have given a p(ledge)’ vihita-pratijYaH-gfhItakzaRaH-ahaM.
Ⓑ
 4 pratiBUH, lagnakaH, baMDakaH.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓnyas 4 U, nikzip 6 P, A-ni-DA 3 U, pari-, paR 1 A, ADI-nyAsI-kf 8 U.
Ⓑ
 2 (Oneʼs word) pratiSru 5 P, pratijYA 9 A, (with dat. of person), urIkf, vacanena baMD 9 P; ex. by (s.); asmatsOdAminIsamakzamanayorvftteyaM pratijYA (Mal. 1) ‘they two p(ledg)ed their word’ &c.; ‘he has p(ledg)ed his virtue (honor) that he would not harm you’ tava virUpakaraRe tena sukftamaMtare DftaM (P. iv. 1); ‘he who has p(ledg)ed his word’ kfta-vihita-pratijYaH, pratijYA-vacana-badDaH, dattavacanaH-pratijYaH, gfhItakzaRaH.
Plenitude,Ⓒs.ⒹpUrRatA, prAcuryaM, vEpulyaM, samfdDi f., atirekaH, utsekaH, parA kowiH-kAzWA.

Plenty,Ⓒs.ⒹbAhulyaM, prAcuryaM, vEpulyaM, bahutvaM, samfdDi f., udrekaH, atirekaH, utsekaH, sPIti-vfdDi f.
ⓃPlenteous, Plentiful,Ⓒa.ⒹpraBUta, pracura, vipula, bahu, bahula, BUri, BUyizWa, puzkala, samfdDa, saM-pari-pUrRa, udrikta, sPIta, utsikta, upacita.
Ⓝ[Plentiful]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹbAhulyena, bahuSaH, BUyizWaM, BUri, praBUtaM, vipulaM, atiriktaM.
Ⓝ[Plentiful]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹbAhulyaM, prAcuryaM; See (s.).
